title: Simply Staffchat
description: Simple Staff chat for your Team.
body:
TeamChat is a lightweight staff communication plugin for Paper 1.21.1 servers. It adds a private team chat channel that is only visible to players with the appropriate permission — perfect for admins, moderators, and other staff roles to communicate without players seeing their messages.

-Features

/sc <message> — Send a one-off message directly to team chat
/teamchattoggle — Toggle mode: every message you type in normal chat is automatically redirected to team chat instead of public chat. Toggle it off to go back to normal.
/teamreload — Reload the config without restarting the server
Fully configurable chat format with & color code support
Clean [TEAM] prefix to clearly distinguish staff messages from public chat
Toggle state is stored per player in memory — no database required
Console receives all team chat messages (configurable)

-Permissions

Node	        Description	                                 Default
teamchat.use	Send team chat messages & use the toggle	|OP
teamchat.see	Receive and read team chat messages	        |OP
teamchat.reload	Reload the configuration	                |OP
teamchat.*	    Grants all permissions	                    |OP

-Requirements

Paper (or any Paper fork) 1.21.1
Java 21+
No dependencies — drop in and go
Configuration
The format string, all player-facing messages and console logging are fully customizable via config.yml.
